description: This file is a shell script containing test cases for Git merge scenarios, specifically designed to test various merge behaviors including renames, directory renames, and conflict resolution strategies.

methods.name: test_setup_1a
methods.description: Sets up a git repository for merge test case involving no renames, where one side has a subset of the other's changes.

methods.name: test_expect_success '1a-L'
methods.description: Tests the merge operation with no renames, ensuring the changes are correctly recognized and the proper commit is produced.

methods.name: test_expect_success '1a-R'
methods.description: Same as above, with roles reversed to verify merge correctness.

methods.name: test_setup_2a
methods.description: Prepares a repository for testing merge behavior with a basic rename on one branch.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2a-L'
methods.description: Tests merge with a rename, verifying the rename is correctly handled.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2a-R'
methods.description: Reverse scenario of '2a-L' to test merge consistency.

methods.name: test_setup_2b
methods.description: Sets up a scenario where a file is changed and renamed on one branch, while the other has a different modification.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2b-L'
methods.description: Tests merge where a file has been renamed and modified on one branch, ensuring correct content and path handling.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2b-R'
methods.description: Reverse scenario of '2b-L'.

methods.name: test_setup_2c
methods.description: Prepares a scenario with conflicting modifications and renames to test conflict detection and resolution.

methods.name: test_expect_success '2c'
methods.description: Verifies that a merge conflict occurs as expected when renaming and modifying files in conflicting ways.

methods.name: test_setup_3a
methods.description: Sets up directory renames combined with file renames and modifications for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3a-L'
methods.description: Tests merge with directory renames and file modifications on one branch.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3a-R'
methods.description: Tests reverse scenario of directory and file renames for merge.

methods.name: test_setup_3b
methods.description: Prepares a scenario involving directory renames with additional file modifications.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3b-L'
methods.description: Tests directory renames and modifications merged into one branch.

methods.name: test_expect_success '3b-R'
methods.description: Reverse of '3b-L', checking merge behavior.

methods.name: test_setup_4a
methods.description: Creates a test case with local modifications and a merge scenario where both sides have changed the same file.

methods.name: test_expect_success '4a'
methods.description: Tests that in-memory merge preserves local modifications when changes are subsets of each other.

methods.name: test_setup_4b
methods.description: Sets up a scenario where a file has been renamed and modified on one branch, with local modifications.

methods.name: test_expect_success '4b'
methods.description: Verifies merge behavior with renames, modifications, and local changes.
